title: Not worth the money, more like a $5 blanket.
text: Not worth the money, more like a $5 blanket.. While it looks like the picture it is very cheaply made for the price, I got a better blanket at the M&M store for $5. than the quality of this blanket. Very thin.

product_metadata.title: Jay Franco Marvel Deadpool Maximum Effort Throw, Gray
features: PERFECT FIT & FUN DESIGN - Deadpool fleece throw measures 46 x 60 inches. Add a touch of decorative enchantment to your room with our fashionable and super soft Marvel Deadpool throw. Fun and colorful design features your child’s favorite hero, Deadpool.

HIGH QUALITY & EASY CARE - Keep your little one as cozy as can be! Super soft Fleece is great for all seasons. Our soft to touch throw allows for a comfortable night's sleep. To clean, machine wash cold. To dry, air/tumble dry on low.

GREAT GIFT – This Marvel Deadpool 46 x 60 inches throw will make any child smile and will transform any bedroom, guest room, kids room, RV, or vacation home. Great gift for school or home. It rolls up for easy storage and travel.
SHOP THE DEADPOOL COLLECTION - Complete your bedroom with our other Marvel Deadpool products - Coordinating bedding and accessories available (sold separately).

OUR FAMILY COMPANY - Our company is still small and family run. We take great pride in our products and our unsurpassed customer service. We know that our wonderful customers are the reason we are in business! We offer excellent quality, non-toxic products. With our coordinating Deadpool accessories, you can mix and match our high-quality and unique boy’s comforter sets, girl’s comforter sets, kids sheet sets, or kids pillows.
description: Enjoy the comfort, warmth and coziness of this Deadpool throw blanket all year round. Perfect for bedroom, living room or take it in the car for short or long road trips. Fans of all ages are sure to love seeing Deadpool while getting into bed. This super soft and plush throw blanket makes the perfect gift. Toss over existing bedding for an additional layer during the cold months or drape over you on a chair while reading a book. Blanket measures 42" x 60". Synthetic material is easy to care for. Easy care, machine washable polyester.
